alternatives.option: Extend plugin-tool-references.test.ts to the site's markdown
alternatives.reason_rejected: assertion-based guard on a third doc family; table text can still rot between test runs and the test parser grows more brittle

context: Wrote the docs-site design spec (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-01-docs-site-design.md): VitePress site under docs/site/, ~29 pages, generated tool tables, candid evolution chapter, stale-docs fix wave.
rationale: Guarding at the source beats guarding by assertion: generation makes drift structurally impossible for schema-level claims, while extending the pinning test to a third document family would grow a parser that already special-cases two. The stub-server census pattern is proven in test/plugin-tool-references.test.ts. Resolves the open need 01M11XB7AGN1KAJ47A3E9WDWV1.
summary: Chose to generate the site's tool reference from the server registry via the stub-server pattern (extract-tools.mjs → tools.json, CI freshness diff) rather than hand-write tables guarded by extending plugin-tool-references.test.ts
